regions.merged_text: Monday 25, 1935 - Conference - Personal Responsability - why did God prefer me - for creation - to be a Capuchin? Obedience - naturally hard - against grain of tainted nature- Conference. Conference - B1. Poverty - How possible when nothing necessary is wanting? Simply by asking for permission to use whatever may be given us - Extra: by contenting ourselves with what we get.
